Interface Catalog

All Known Implementing Classes:
InMemoryCatalog
public interface Catalog
Catalog port. Each operation is atomic; successful mutations advance a version once. No-op additions, updates, removals, and equal replacements preserve the version. Implementations must return immutable detached snapshots and changes.
